notes.sowing: Start seeds indoors at {c:21} to {c:24}, 4 to 6 weeks before your last frost, {cm:0.6} deep; seedlings appear in about a week. Plant out after the last frost, or sow directly once the soil is above {c:18}.
notes.care: Grow in full sun, {cm:20} to {cm:25} apart, and deadhead faded flowers to keep blooms coming. Grown as a dense cover crop, some varieties reduce root-knot nematodes in the soil, but single plants dotted among vegetables do not protect their neighbors.
notes.harvest: Flowers open about 7 to 8 weeks from sowing and continue until a hard frost. Cut stems for small bouquets as the flowers open.
